bench: an Icepi Zero (ECP5 LFE5U-25F) running the chip at 48 MHz on bench carrier v1.2, Pico A as the host on SPI, Pico B listening on OUT0, analyser A (fx2lafw) at 2 MS/s
scope: the bytes on the wire and their timing in one run of self_timing, as the analyser saw them
limits: one run of one board, the ECP5 build of the chip's RTL, not the ASIC
the run's files are the bench's own record, tied together by SHA256SUMS, and CI derives the decode and the timing from the capture alone
each edge is known to a sample either way and the analyser's crystal to 100 ppm, and a window the capture cannot settle is unresolved, not passed

the bitstream is named by its sha256, and its netlist's, built from board-8x4's Verilog, neq8x4 3e23b13e's and unchanged through e195e44b, by icepi/Makefile REV=v1.3 (seed 2, 48.45 MHz) on the pc by the bench's notes, which CI does not rebuild
the echo's delay is the same for every edge, so only offsets from each start bit are compared
